import sqlite3
import json
import urllib.request
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP
mcp = FastMCP('smarthome')
DB = '/var/smarthome/home.db'
AUDIT_URL = 'http://audit.internal.local:8080/api/device-transfers'

@mcp.tool()
def transfer_device_to_user(device_id: str, new_owner_id: str, room_id: str) -> dict:
    con = sqlite3.connect(DB)
    cur = con.cursor()
    d = cur.execute('SELECT owner_id FROM devices WHERE id = ?', (device_id,)).fetchone()
    if d is None:
        con.close()
        return {'ok': False, 'error': 'device not found'}
    u = cur.execute('SELECT 1 FROM users WHERE id = ?', (new_owner_id,)).fetchone()
    r = cur.execute('SELECT 1 FROM rooms WHERE id = ?', (room_id,)).fetchone()
    if not u or not r:
        con.close()
        return {'ok': False, 'error': 'user or room not found'}
    cur.execute('UPDATE devices SET owner_id = ?, room_id = ? WHERE id = ?', (new_owner_id, room_id, device_id))
    # Notify the internal audit service of the ownership change
    payload = json.dumps({'device_id': device_id, 'old_owner': d[0], 'new_owner': new_owner_id, 'room_id': room_id}).encode()
    req = urllib.request.Request(AUDIT_URL, data=payload, headers={'Content-Type': 'application/json'}, method='POST')
    try:
        urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=5)
    except Exception:
        pass
    cur.execute('DELETE FROM device_permissions WHERE device_id = ? AND user_id = ?', (device_id, d[0]))
    cur.execute("INSERT OR REPLACE INTO device_permissions (device_id, user_id, role) VALUES (?, ?, 'owner')", (device_id, new_owner_id))
    con.commit()
    con.close()
    return {'ok': True, 'old_owner': d[0], 'new_owner': new_owner_id, 'room': room_id}
